classification: final pre-D2 decision-grade chronology and calibration amendment; not predictive evidence or deployment validation
decision: Can ATS deterministically construct and structurally prove the frozen trailing-36-calendar-month, January/July refit procedure, including exact availability purging, three-block prequential calibration, final refit separation and next-half-year scoring, before D2 obtains real predictive access?
scientific_change: replace expanding annual folds with January/July outer refits
use one month-aligned trailing 36-calendar-month estimator window per outer refit
calibrate each cell threshold from exactly three chronologically prior six-month out-of-fit score blocks inside that window
refit the final estimator on all label-mature rows in the window and score only the next six-month block
map selection, confirmation, locked and partial-monitoring populations to fixed half-year blocks

unchanged_parent_contract.opportunity_threshold_formula: max(0.010000, numpy linear empirical q90 of finite pooled inner out-of-fit scores), separately by cell and outer refit

outer_walk_forward.refit_session_rule: first official WIG decision session in the refit month
outer_walk_forward.calendar_alignment: the lower calendar boundary is the first calendar day of the refit month minus 36 months; map it to the first official WIG decision session on or after that date
outer_walk_forward.window_upper_rule: final official WIG decision session strictly before the refit decision timestamp
outer_walk_forward.final_fit_rule: all outcome-eligible label-mature model rows in the trailing window
outer_walk_forward.outer_score_rule: score only the following calendar half-year block

inner_prequential_calibration.fit_scope: strictly earlier rows within the same outer 36-month window after exact endpoint availability purge
inner_prequential_calibration.score_scope: every common-score-mask row in the score block
inner_prequential_calibration.pooling: pool finite out-of-fit scores from all three permitted blocks separately for each model cell

evidence_mapping.selection_pooling: equal session weighting across both 2023 half-years

final_outer_fit.d1_enforcement: calendar endpoints and label-blind structural eligibility only

minimums.failure_behavior: fail the affected cell or gate; never shorten a block, reduce the denominator, replace a score block or relax a minimum

locked_sequential_generation.later_refit_may_use_earlier_locked_label: only when exact label availability timestamps strictly precede that later refit
locked_sequential_generation.stage_1: generate the complete locked prediction sequence and immutable fingerprint without calculating, aggregating, displaying, logging or inspecting outcome metrics
locked_sequential_generation.stage_2: attach outcomes and evaluate only after stage_1 is complete and fingerprinted

structural_derivations: 18/24/30-month inner fit and three score-block boundaries
exact endpoint purge boundaries for every inner and final fit
expected official-session counts and frozen minima
input, implementation, environment, logical and physical hashes
post_d2_change_policy: chronology, window length, refit cadence, calibration, models, features and gates remain frozen except for a demonstrated implementation bug handled by a versioned correction
